question: Centre for Excellence of Classical Tamil was shifted from Mysore to Chennai in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2008**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Centre for Excellence for Classical Tamil (CECT) was initially established in Mysore, Karnataka.
 
• It was later relocated to Chennai, Tamil Nadu, in 2008.
 
• The shift aimed to consolidate the center's operations and bring it closer to the heart of the Tamil linguistic and cultural community.
 
• Chennai, being the capital of Tamil Nadu, offered better infrastructure and resources for the center's activities.
 
• The move facilitated greater collaboration with Tamil scholars, institutions, and the general public.
 
• The CECT plays a crucial role in promoting research and study in Classical Tamil literature, linguistics, and culture.
 
• It supports various academic initiatives, including conferences, seminars, and workshops.
 
• The center also provides fellowships and scholarships to researchers and students.
 
• It works towards preserving and digitizing ancient Tamil texts.
 
• The CECT aims to make Classical Tamil literature accessible to a wider audience.
 
• It collaborates with universities and research institutions globally to promote Tamil studies.
 
• The center's activities contribute to the understanding and appreciation of the rich heritage of the Tamil language.
 
• Classical Tamil is recognized as one of the oldest surviving classical languages in the world.
 
• The CECT's work is essential for preserving this linguistic and cultural treasure.
 
• The shift to Chennai has strengthened the center's ability to achieve its objectives.
 
• The relocation has provided the CECT with a more conducive environment for its research and academic endeavors.
 
• The center actively engages in outreach programs to promote the study of Classical Tamil.
 
• It publishes research findings and educational materials related to Classical Tamil.
 
• The CECT serves as a hub for scholars and enthusiasts of the Tamil language and its literature.
